# POST /api/owners — Complete Owner Creation Call Chain

All paths are absolute. Note: security is only active when `petclinic.security.enable=true` (`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/security/BasicAuthenticationConfig.java:20`); otherwise `DisableSecurityConfig` applies.

## 1. The @RestController method mapping POST /api/owners

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`
- Class is `@RestController @RequestMapping("/api")` implementing `OwnersApi` (lines 51-54).
- The handler (lines 99-109):
```java
@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")     // line 99
@Override
public ResponseEntity<OwnerDto> addOwner(OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto) {
    HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
    Owner owner = ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto);   // line 103
    this.clinicService.saveOwner(owner);                 // line 104
    OwnerDto ownerDto = ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner);   // line 105
    headers.setLocation(... "/api/owners/{id}" ... owner.getId());  // 106-107
    return new ResponseEntity<>(ownerDto, headers, HttpStatus.CREATED);  // line 108
}
```
The actual HTTP mapping (`POST /owners`, consumes/produces JSON, `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto`) is inherited from the generated interface `OwnersApi` at `/home/daniel/sandbox/target/generated-sources/openapi/.../rest/api/OwnersApi.java:79-87` (`@RequestMapping(method=POST, value="/owners")`, param annotated `@Valid @RequestBody`). The interface is `@Validated` (line 44). There is NO V2 POST — `OwnerRestControllerV2` only exposes `GET` listOwnersPage.

## 2. Request-body DTO and ALL Bean Validation annotations

`/home/daniel/sandbox/target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/dto/OwnerFieldsDto.java` (`@Valid`-triggered validation on the getters):
- `firstName` (line 76): `@NotNull @Pattern(regexp = "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$") @Size(min = 1, max = 30)`
- `lastName` (line 97): `@NotNull @Pattern(regexp = "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$") @Size(min = 1, max = 30)`
- `address` (line 118): `@NotNull @Size(min = 1, max = 255)`
- `city` (line 139): `@NotNull @Size(min = 1, max = 80)`
- `telephone` (line 160): `@NotNull @Pattern(regexp = "^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$") @Size(min = 1, max = 20)`
- `email` (line 181): `@Size(max = 255)` (nullable)
- `postcode` (line 202): `@Pattern(regexp = "^[0-9]{4}$")` (nullable)
- `registrationDate` (line 223): `@Valid` (nullable `LocalDate`, `@DateTimeFormat ISO.DATE`)
- `birthDate` (line 244): `@Valid` (nullable `LocalDate`)
- `sharesHousehold` (lines 256-275): nullable `Boolean`, no constraint. Drives the household-duplicate bypass.

No custom `ConstraintValidator`/`@Validated` groups exist; all extra rules are implemented as advice (below).

## 3 & 4. Everything that executes, in order

### Phase A — RequestBodyAdvice: run AFTER Jackson deserializes the body but BEFORE `@Valid` bean validation and before the controller
All of these are `@ControllerAdvice extends RequestBodyAdviceAdapter`, `supports()` matching `OwnerFieldsDto`, and all annotated `@Order(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE)` — so their relative order among each other is UNSPECIFIED (Spring gives them the same precedence). They mutate the DTO and/or throw. Some restrict `supports()` to `addOwner` only.

Mutating advices:
- `OwnerTelephoneNormalizationAdvice` (`.../advice/OwnerTelephoneNormalizationAdvice.java:53-94`): rewrites `telephone` to E.164 (`toE164`): strips non-digits; if no leading `+`, drops a leading `0` and prepends `61`; requires 8–15 digits else throws `InvalidTelephoneException` → 400. Then `checkNationalLength`: `+61` must have 9 national digits, `+1` must have 10, else 400.
- `OwnerEmailNormalizationAdvice` (`.../OwnerEmailNormalizationAdvice.java:55-72`): if email present, `strip().toLowerCase()`; must match email regex else `InvalidEmailException` → 400. Sets normalized email back on DTO.
- `OwnerAddressNormalizationAdvice` (`.../OwnerAddressNormalizationAdvice.java:53-75`): trims/collapses whitespace, upper-cases, expands ST→STREET, RD→ROAD, AVE→AVENUE; sets back on DTO.
- `OwnerRegistrationDateAdvice` (`.../OwnerRegistrationDateAdvice.java:47-53`): sets `registrationDate = RegistrationBusinessDay.effective(...)` — missing date defaults to `LocalDate.now()`, and Sat/Sun roll forward to Monday (`RegistrationBusinessDay.java:33-42`).

Validating/rejecting advices (throw → mapped to error status):
- `OwnerFieldsValidationAdvice` (`.../OwnerFieldsValidationAdvice.java:53-83`): if firstName/lastName/address/city/telephone blank → `MissingOwnerFieldsException` → 400 with body `{"errors":[...]}`.
- `OwnerDisposableEmailAdvice` (`.../OwnerDisposableEmailAdvice.java:54-74`): rejects email domains mailinator.com/tempmail.com/guerrillamail.com → 400.
- `OwnerPostcodeValidationAdvice` (`.../OwnerPostcodeValidationAdvice.java:55-73`): if city is Sydney/Melbourne/Brisbane, postcode must be within region base..base+99 (2000/3000/4000) → else 400.
- `OwnerFutureRegistrationDateAdvice` (`.../OwnerFutureRegistrationDateAdvice.java:50-57`): supplied `registrationDate` after `LocalDate.now()` → 400. (Runs on the raw supplied value; ordering vs. the defaulting advice is unspecified since both are HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE.)
- `OwnerHouseholdDuplicateAdvice` (`.../OwnerHouseholdDuplicateAdvice.java:58-71`): unless `sharesHousehold==true`, computes `householdId` (SHA-256 of normalized lastName+postcode, first 12 hex) and calls `clinicService.findAllOwners()`; if any existing owner shares it → `DuplicateHouseholdException` → 409.
- `OwnerUniqueIdentityAdvice` (`.../OwnerUniqueIdentityAdvice.java:63-75`, addOwner only): builds `normalizedTelephone|email` and compares against `findAllOwners()`; exact match → `DuplicateIdentityException` → 409.
- `OwnerDailyCreationLimitAdvice` (`.../OwnerDailyCreationLimitAdvice.java:64-76`, addOwner only): counts existing owners with same effective business-day `registrationDate`; if ≥100 → `DailyLimitReachedException` → 429.
- `OwnerCityCapacityAdvice` (`.../OwnerCityCapacityAdvice.java:64-76`, addOwner only): counts owners in same normalized city; if ≥50 → `CityAtCapacityException` → 409.

Each rejecting advice declares its own `@ExceptionHandler` returning the status above. Identity key logic shared via `OwnerIdentityKey` (`.../OwnerIdentityKey.java`).

### Phase B — Bean Validation
After body advice, Spring validates `@Valid OwnerFieldsDto` against the constraints in section 2. Failures → `MethodArgumentNotValidException`, handled in `ExceptionControllerAdvice.handleMethodArgumentNotValidException` (`.../advice/ExceptionControllerAdvice.java:132-163`) → 400 ProblemDetail with `schemaValidationErrors`.

### Phase C — Controller + mapping
- `ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto)` — generated impl `/home/daniel/sandbox/target/generated-sources/annotations/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapperImpl.java:87-106`: new `Owner`, copies firstName, lastName, postcode, birthDate, email, registrationDate, address, city, telephone. `id` and `pets` are NOT set (declared ignore in `OwnerMapper.java:37-39`), so `owner.isNew()==true`.

### Phase D — Service call `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)` — wrapped by AspectJ aspects
`ClinicServiceImpl.saveOwner` (`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicServiceImpl.java:232-237`) is `@Transactional` and just calls `ownerRepository.save(owner)`. Around/before it, these `@Aspect @Component` beans fire on `execution(* ClinicService.saveOwner(..))` (no `@Order` among them → order UNSPECIFIED):
- `OwnerHouseholdSizeAdvice` `@Before` (`.../advice/OwnerHouseholdSizeAdvice.java:42-51`): if new and `householdSize==null`, counts existing owners sharing householdId via `ownerRepository.findAll()`, sets `householdSize = existing+1`.
- `OwnerNamesakeCountAdvice` `@Before` (`.../advice/OwnerNamesakeCountAdvice.java:40-48`): if new and `namesakeCount==null`, counts existing owners with same first+last name (case-insensitive), sets `namesakeCount`.
- `OwnerCustomerCodeAdvice` `@Before` (`.../advice/OwnerCustomerCodeAdvice.java:43-58`): if new and `customerCode==null`, sets `customerCode = REGION-<HASH8>` where REGION from postcode band (NSW/VIC/QLD or UNKNOWN) and HASH8 = first 4 bytes of SHA-256(telephone+lastName) as hex.
- `OwnerAuditCreationAdvice` `@Around` (`.../advice/OwnerAuditCreationAdvice.java:39-48`): captures `isNew()`, calls `proceed()`, then if it was new logs to the `AUDIT` SLF4J logger: `owner created id=.. customerCode=.. registrationDate=..`.

Note: the two `@Before` aspects and CustomerCode aspect all mutate the owner before persistence; because `@Before` vs `@Around`(which does `proceed()`) ordering is unspecified, the audit log's id/customerCode reflect whatever completed first, but all mutation happens before `em.persist`.

### Phase E — Persistence
`OwnerRepository.save` JPA impl `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/jpa/JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.java:92-100`: `owner.getId()==null` → `em.persist(owner)` (else merge). `@Transactional` on the service method commits after return.

### Phase F — Response mapping + ResponseBodyAdvice
- `ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner)` — `OwnerMapperImpl.java:24-60`: copies persisted fields and DERIVES many response-only fields: `displayName`, `initials`, `householdId`, `identityKey` (`OwnerIdentityKey.of`), `checkDigit` (`OwnerCheckDigit.of`), `membershipNumber`, `membershipPoints`/`membershipLevel` (`OwnerMembershipLevel`, which reads `householdSize>=3`, email, namesakeCount==0, tenure>365d — see `.../advice/OwnerMembershipLevel.java:36-59`), `locality`, `contactPreference` (EMAIL/PHONE), `ageBand` (`OwnerAgeBand.of`), `telephoneDisplay` (`OwnerTelephoneDisplay.of`).
- Then `ResponseBodyAdvice` beans run (`supports` returns true for all):
  - `OwnerBulkSignupWarningAdvice.beforeBodyWrite` (`.../advice/OwnerBulkSignupWarningAdvice.java:54-67`): calls `findAllOwners()`, counts those registered today; sets `bulkSignupWarning = count>80`.
  - `OwnerPossibleDuplicateAdvice.beforeBodyWrite` (`.../advice/OwnerPossibleDuplicateAdvice.java:44-53`): forces `possibleDuplicate=false`, `possibleDuplicateOf=null`.
- Controller returns 201 CREATED with `Location: /api/owners/{id}` header.

## 5. Entity + JPA lifecycle / auditing

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — `@Entity @Table(name="owners")` extends `Person`. Columns: address `@NotEmpty` (39-40), city `@NotEmpty` (43-44), telephone `@NotEmpty @Pattern("^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$")` (47-49), email, postcode, registrationDate, birthDate, customerCode, namesakeCount, householdSize (all plain `@Column`), and `pets` `@OneToMany(cascade=ALL, mappedBy="owner", fetch=EAGER)` (112-113).
- Superclass `Person` (`model/Person.java`) `@MappedSuperclass`: firstName `@NotEmpty` (32-33), lastName `@NotEmpty` (36-37).
- `BaseEntity` (`model/BaseEntity.java`): `@Id @GeneratedValue(strategy=IDENTITY)` id (33-35); `isNew()` = `id==null` (45-47).

There are NO `@PrePersist`/`@PostPersist` callbacks and NO Spring Data `@CreatedDate`/`@EntityListeners` auditing anywhere on Owner/Person/BaseEntity. All "defaulting/audit" behavior is done by the aspects in Phase D, not JPA callbacks. (There is entity-level bean validation via Hibernate Validator on `@NotEmpty`/`@Pattern` at flush time.)

## 6. @ControllerAdvice / security / interceptors / transactions

- Global exception handling: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/advice/ExceptionControllerAdvice.java` — `@ExceptionHandler` for `AccessDeniedException` (rethrows so Security produces 403, lines 83-86), `MethodArgumentNotValidException` → 400 (132-163), `DataIntegrityViolationException` → 404 (112-123), catch-all `Exception` → 500 (95-102). Note: the per-advice inner exception handlers (Disposable/Telephone/Postcode/Household/Identity/DailyLimit/CityCapacity/MissingFields) are local to those advices and take precedence for their own exception types.
- Security: `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")` on `addOwner` (controller line 99). `@roles` resolves to the `Roles` bean (`security/Roles.java:8`, `OWNER_ADMIN="ROLE_OWNER_ADMIN"`). Method security enabled by `@EnableMethodSecurity(prePostEnabled=true)` in `security/BasicAuthenticationConfig.java:19`, gated on `petclinic.security.enable=true` (line 20). Filter chain: CSRF disabled, all requests authenticated, HTTP Basic, JDBC users/roles (lines 34-54). A `BCryptPasswordEncoder` bean exists (27-29) but NO password encoding happens in the owner-creation path (owners have no password). When security is disabled, `DisableSecurityConfig` is active instead.
- Transactions: only `ClinicServiceImpl.saveOwner` is `@Transactional` (service line 233); the controller `addOwner` is not transactional (only `deleteOwner` carries `@Transactional`). The many `findAllOwners()` calls made by the RequestBodyAdvice run in their own read transactions before the save transaction opens.
- Interceptors/filters/aspects specific to this endpoint: the Spring MVC `RequestBodyAdvice` chain (Phase A), `ResponseBodyAdvice` chain (Phase F), and the four AspectJ aspects around `saveOwner` (Phase D). No custom `HandlerInterceptor` or servlet `Filter` beyond Spring Security's filter chain was found.

### Important ordering caveat
Every `RequestBodyAdvice` uses `@Order(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE)` and the four save-time aspects have no `@Order`, so within each phase the execution order is not deterministic from the code. This matters where advices both mutate and validate the same field (e.g., telephone normalization vs. the DTO `@Pattern`, or registration-date defaulting vs. future-date rejection).
